When on, only the facts of the current alert (e.g. which app was flagged, which link looks suspicious) or your question to the cat are sent to Meta\'s AI to generate a plain-language explanation. Voice input sends the recording to Meta\'s AI for transcription; no audio file is kept. Your contacts, photos, and full message texts never leave the phone. Off by default; you can turn it off anytime.
